req.title: Task has default completed=false
req.statement: The system shall default the completed field to false when POST /tasks/ omits it.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-016 requires that POST /tasks/ defaults completed=false when the field is omitted. Three test cases are designed: (1) EP positive — omit completed entirely, assert response body has completed==false and status==201; (2) NEG negative — explicitly send completed=true to confirm the field IS accepted when provided (proving the default only applies when omitted, not that completed is always forced false — a mutation that always sets completed=false would fail this); (3) BVA boundary — send a payload with completed explicitly set to false (the boundary value itself) to confirm the default value matches the explicit value, catching mutations that invert the default (true instead of false). Together these three tests kill: boolean-negation mutations on the default, constant-flip mutations on the HTTP status code, and field-omission vs field-presence logic mutations.

tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app
from app.database import Base, engine

Base.metadata.drop_all(bind=engine)
Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)

client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_task_omits_completed_defaults_to_false():
    payload = {"title": "Default completed test"}
    r = client.post("/tasks/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    body = r.json()
    assert body["completed"] == False
    assert body["title"] == "Default completed test"
    assert isinstance(body["id"], int)

test_post_task_omits_completed_defaults_to_false()

tests.name: test_post_task_explicit_completed_false_matches_default
preconditions: Request body explicitly sets completed=false (the boundary/default value)
actions: POST /tasks/ with JSON body {"title": "Explicit false", "completed": false}
Capture HTTP response status code and JSON body
Also POST /tasks/ omitting completed and compare both responses' completed field
expected: Explicit false and omitted completed produce identical completed values
trace: R-TASK-016: default value false must equal explicitly supplied false
BVA: tests the exact boundary value (false) that is the default
Catches mutation flipping default from false to true
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app
from app.database import Base, engine

Base.metadata.drop_all(bind=engine)
Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)

client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_task_explicit_completed_false_matches_default():
    r_explicit = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "Explicit false", "completed": False})
    assert r_explicit.status_code == 201
    body_explicit = r_explicit.json()
    assert body_explicit["completed"] == False

    r_omitted = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "Omitted completed"})
    assert r_omitted.status_code == 201
    body_omitted = r_omitted.json()
    assert body_omitted["completed"] == False

    assert body_explicit["completed"] == body_omitted["completed"]

test_post_task_explicit_completed_false_matches_default()
